parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides better risk alignment (moderate risk_level matching user's moderate tolerance vs. A's inconsistent low/moderate labels) and adds a valuable tax optimization recommendation grounded in the user's actual income/expense data. While A offers more granular year-by-year detail and actionability, B's recommendations are more holistic and factually consistent (A misstates current allocation as 55% equity when it's actually 55% equity/35% bond/5% MF/5% cash and contains internal contradictions about starting allocation).
